answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President (party statement, quoted by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01)
answer.new_information: Corning's CEO says the company is in its fastest growth period and will probably double in size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in the US. The period is undated ('coming years') and the metric is company size, not NVDA revenue, capacity or shipments, so it does not match any NVDA question's period or definition. The Corning-NVIDIA project (three optical facilities in North Carolina and Texas, more than 3,000 jobs, tenfold US optical capacity) is a Fox News relay with no completion date, no capex or revenue figure and no NVIDIA-side confirmation. The Wistron item is Fox News reporting with no job count or date. None of this moves a stored number, probability or risk, and no catalog question or stored piece exists to revise.
answer.reason: No catalog questions or stored pieces were supplied, so there is no argument to update. The record is a sizeless, undated pickup on Corning's own growth and a relayed NVIDIA partnership with no completion date or NVIDIA-side figures. It is context only and does not meet the bar for propose_new, since it carries no investment judgement that could change the NVDA position.
